filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Nov 18 (after the morning run) – Thu Nov 19 morning PT (items already on the Nov 17–18 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: Sales tools are taking two routes at once: plugging their data and skills into ChatGPT (Attio and Outreach on Nov 18, following Tuesday's ChatGPT for Sales launch) and shipping their own agents that run on context the vendor already holds, as Clay did on Nov 19.

bullets.text: Nov 19: Clay's global agent (open beta, paid plans) plans, builds and tests GTM plays across Search, Audiences, Workflows and Sequencer, reading the customer's ICP and personas from Knowledge Hub and showing an estimated cost for approval before running at volume.

Nov 18: Attio relaunched its ChatGPT plugin with dozens of prebuilt sales skills (call briefs, forecasts, an end-of-day skill that logs activity and proposes deal updates) under each user's Attio permissions; Outreach added MCP tools that let outside agents edit records and create sequences and tasks.

Nov 18: Benioff says 226K custom agents from builders such as OpenAI, Cognition, Vercel and Lovable are deployed in Slack, which Salesforce now pitches as agent infrastructure with identity, an MCP gateway and DLP/retention controls.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83; ANT trades today
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 18: 980M shares raised $81.34B (above the $70–78 range) plus a $26B concurrent private placement; ~$1.5T fully diluted. CNBC had ANT indicated near $111 ahead of the first trade this morning.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 18: mid-tier model for coding and enterprise work at $3/$15 per M tokens with a 1M-token context, rolling out in the Gemini API, Gemini for business and Antigravity.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI adds ChatGPT for Accounting
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 18: second packaged job plugin after Sales, with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, BILL and others; Enterprise admins must approve it, and entries need user review before posting.

what_changed.title: Clay launches its global agent in open beta
what_changed.body: Nov 19: an agent in Clay's Agent tab turns a described play into a segment, signals, enrichment workflow and draft sequence, tests it on sample records, then asks for approval with an estimated cost. It reads Knowledge Hub and Audiences (CRM, warehouse, Gong calls, emails), saves reusable skills, and uses data credits; open beta on paid Enterprise, Growth and Launch plans.

what_changed.title: Attio relaunches its ChatGPT plugin
what_changed.body: Nov 18: Attio home view in ChatGPT, @-mention any record, dozens of prebuilt sales skills including meeting prep, forecasting and an /end-of-day skill that logs calls and emails to records and drafts replies; ChatGPT only sees what the user can see in Attio.

what_changed.title: Outreach opens more write actions to outside agents
what_changed.body: Nov 18: new Outreach MCP server tools for editing records, creating sequences and tasks, and Kaia coaching cards; new MCP connectors for G2 intent, Freshdesk, Vidyard and LeanData; Yoodli role play built from deal context. Available now.

what_changed.title: Monaco gives its ANT IPO shares to new customers
what_changed.body: Nov 18: CEO Sam Blond says every customer who signs up in November gets 10 ANT shares, which he framed as marketing spend going to customers instead of ad tracking.

quiet_note: No launch, funding, M&A or pricing of their own from Gong, Nooks or Salesloft dated Nov 18–19. Qualified's Piper for Sales (agent that joins Zoom/Google Meet sales calls, GA Q1 2027) was announced Nov 17 and is on the Salesforce page; Salesforce's Nov 19 Cyber Week forecast and American SI export consortium are not GTM news.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (CRM and engagement data inside ChatGPT)
market_direction.text: Attio's relaunched plugin and Outreach's new MCP write tools (Nov 18) follow the Nov 17 ChatGPT for Sales launch.

market_direction.label: New (vendor-native agents built on the vendor's own GTM context)
market_direction.text: Clay's global agent (Nov 19) builds and tests full plays in-product and charges for them in credits, with approval before spending.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (collaboration suites as agent runtime)
market_direction.text: Salesforce counts 226K custom agents in Slack and pitches identity, MCP gateway and DLP as the platform (Nov 18).

market_direction.label: Steady (Gong, Nooks, Salesloft)
market_direction.text: No announcements of their own Nov 18–19.

New MCP write tools, G2/Freshdesk/Vidyard/LeanData connectors and Yoodli role play (Nov 18).
226K custom agents in Slack; Slack positioned as agent infrastructure (Nov 18).
10 ANT shares for each November sign-up (Nov 18).

watch.title: Fri Nov 20: Claude Data default-on for Enterprise; Anthropic IPO settles
watch.body: Claude Data turns on by default for Enterprise orgs on Nov 20 unless an Owner already saved a setting (Organization settings › Artifacts); certified queries and live sharing stay off. The ANT offering is set to settle the same day.

interpretation.fact: Nov 19 Clay launched a global agent in open beta. Nov 18 Attio relaunched its ChatGPT plugin, Outreach added MCP write tools and partner connectors, Monaco offered 10 ANT shares per November sign-up, and Benioff said 226K custom agents are deployed in Slack. Nov 18 Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 ($81.34B) with trading today; Google released Gemini 4 Neon; OpenAI added ChatGPT for Accounting. Gong, Nooks and Salesloft announced nothing of their own Nov 18–19.
interpretation.interpretation: Vendors are hedging: they expose data and write actions to ChatGPT so they are not shut out of the assistant layer, while building their own agents on context a general assistant lacks (Clay's Knowledge Hub and Audiences) and charging for agent work by usage.

feed.summary: Clay opened its in-product agent in beta: describe a play and it maps and builds it across Search, Audiences, Workflows and Sequencer using your account history.
Benioff said 226K custom agents have been deployed to Slack from agent builder platforms, which he called trusted agent infrastructure.
Monaco will give 10 shares of ANT from its IPO allocation to each customer who signs up in November.
